changeSet.author: taurus
changeSet.comment: The score of a track: all its parts in systems, from which the parts are extracted. At most one for each track among those not removed; removing it soft-deletes it with its versions.
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_track_arrangement_track ON track_arrangement (track_id) WHERE deleted = FALSE;

changeSet.author: taurus
changeSet.comment: Immutable versions of a score: compressed MusicXML with one part for each row, stored as media of the parts. The rows give, for each part of the file, its id, its name and the instruments of the row.

changeSet.author: taurus
changeSet.comment: Versions of the parts extracted from a score, which remember the version of the score they come from, and the row of the score each part is extracted from: unique among the active parts of a track.

changeSet.author: taurus
changeSet.comment: Drafts and edit locks of a score too. The draft of a score keeps the instruments of its rows, which the MusicXML does not carry.
